authority_boundary: This is a design-development scenario and acceptance protocol, not evidence of a real person, field pilot, approval, operator or built condition.

conditions: does not use a smartphone for public services
walks slowly and needs frequent seating
prefers a person and paper over voice interaction
rights: choose a non-AI equivalent without penalty
reach a staffed desk without an account
complain anonymously and receive a paper receipt

day_journey.event: select paper route at the staffed desk
read three-level notice and choose the non-AI lane
robot approaches while accessible priority is active
submit anonymous route-obstruction complaint and receive paper receipt
operator issues temporary Public Verdict: RETURN
continue with paper wayfinding and staffed support
publish de-identified incident state and owner
collect paper response and correction decision

station_handover.question: Can it work inside a bounded envelope?
May this exact version be released for limited public use?
Does the city want this limited use to continue?

minimum_pilot.scale_limit: one specified device, one bounded test pocket, one accessible public bypass; exact dimensions require field survey and approval

phases.action: name candidate operator, site, insurance, safety and accessibility reviewers
field survey, public notice comprehension test and ordinary-use restoration drill
repeat four-fixture tabletop and freeze receipt schema
closed bounded testing without public users inside the machine pocket
independent retest and Test Receipt decision
limited staffed public use with non-AI equivalent
publish complaints, cohort gaps and restoration evidence
issue continue, revise or RETURN verdict

events.reason: remove device and preserve ordinary court
all fixed fixtures and independent stop pass
staff, notice and non-AI route present
public verdict requires spatial and control revision
new fixture and layout must be retested

failure_cases.trigger: localisation uncertainty exceeds the declared envelope tolerance
failure_cases.spatial_action: close machine pocket and observation buffer; keep accessible public route open
failure_cases.data_action: freeze event telemetry and prohibit image retention
failure_cases.return_requirement: independent repeat of loss-of-localisation and stop fixtures

failure_cases.trigger: a software or data licence expires or cannot be linked to the tested version
failure_cases.spatial_action: remove release mark and convert display table to ordinary learning use
failure_cases.data_action: freeze distribution and publish withdrawal state
failure_cases.return_requirement: new rights review tied to exact hashes and withdrawal owner
failure_cases.ordinary_state: open-source clinic and ordinary teaching without the disputed product

failure_cases.trigger: device or queue obstructs the accessible priority route or staffed alternative disappears
failure_cases.spatial_action: stop device, clear crossing and switch to paper and staffed service
failure_cases.data_action: record de-identified complaint and response clock
failure_cases.return_requirement: user-led route test and two review cycles without material cohort gap
failure_cases.ordinary_state: uninterrupted accessible movement and staffed service

acceptance_targets.field_values_status: proposed targets pending operator, official geometry and field audit
